# Gaurav Chaudhary

Google Summer of Code 2026 contributor working with Animint2 in the R Project ecosystem.
:::

## About this journal

This site is a transparent record of weekly progress, engineering decisions, experiments, questions, and verified contributions. It is built with Quarto so technical writing and executable R visualizations live in the same maintainable project.

## About Animint2

Animint2 extends a grammar-of-graphics workflow with linked selections, animation, tooltips, and browser-based interactive output.
